%d 篇网站草稿未纳入发布，请单独同步: %d website drafts are excluded from publishing; sync them individually
RSS 默认保存 Feed 返回的摘要和正文。启用全文提取或离线缓存全文后，还会: RSS saves the summary and body returned by the feed by default. When full-text extraction or offline full-text caching is enabled, the app also visits the original website and saves a sanitized body. No new webpage full text is added while both options are off. Historical webpage snapshots and media caches remain readable.

display.draft-repository-sync-state.proj.zh-Hans: 已写入项目，未同步远端

其余资料默认已勾选；展开后可逐项取消，再确认导入。: The remaining items are selected by default. Expand the list to deselect individual items before confirming the import.
勾选后会在确认导入时保存这条资料: This item will be saved when the import is confirmed
取消勾选后不会保存这条资料: This item will not be saved when deselected
只会保存已勾选的内容；搜索索引在本机建立。: Only selected content will be saved. The search index is built on this Mac.
只同步当前网站草稿到远端；不会纳入批量正式发布，也不会移除 draft 标记。请: Syncs only the current website draft to the remote repository. It is excluded from formal batch publishing and keeps its draft marker. Confirm the remote, branch, and complete file list.
只有启用全文提取或离线缓存全文时，才会从原网站新增净化后的正文；媒体归档已停止新: Sanitized body content is added from the original website only when full-text extraction or offline full-text caching is enabled. New media archives are no longer created; historical data remains available for compatibility.
当前网站草稿的远端同步预览未通过: The remote sync preview for the current website draft did not pass
打开当前网站草稿的单篇同步确认页；不会纳入批量正式发布: Open the single-draft sync confirmation. This draft is excluded from formal batch publishing.
没有待同步文件。: There Are No Files to Sync.
确认后才创建项目 Markdown；以后编辑会自动保存到该文件。: Project Markdown is created only after confirmation. Future edits are saved to that file automatically.
确认后立即同步当前网站草稿: Sync the current website draft after confirmation
网站草稿，默认不参与批量发布: Website draft; excluded from batch publishing by default
通用草稿，不属于站点: General draft; not assigned to a site
